back.en: Transverse: vibrates ⟂ to travel (light, water). Longitudinal: vibrates ∥ (sound)
back.bm: Melintang: getar ⟂ arah gerak (cahaya, air). Membujur: getar ∥ (bunyi)

back.en: Line joining points vibrating in phase; always ⟂ to the direction of travel
back.bm: Garis yang menyambung titik bergetar sefasa; sentiasa ⟂ arah perambatan

back.en: Amplitude decreases as energy is lost; frequency unchanged
back.bm: Amplitud berkurang kerana tenaga hilang; frekuensi tidak berubah

back.en: Driving frequency = natural frequency → maximum amplitude (e.g. tuning a radio)
back.bm: Frekuensi paksa = frekuensi asli → amplitud maksimum (cth. menala radio)

back.en: i = r; speed, f and λ unchanged; direction changes
back.bm: i = r; laju, f dan λ tidak berubah; arah berubah

back.en: Deep → shallow: slower, shorter λ, bends towards the normal; f unchanged
back.bm: Dalam → cetek: lebih perlahan, λ lebih pendek, membias ke arah normal; f tidak berubah

back.en: Waves spread through a gap or around an obstacle; most when gap ≈ λ
back.bm: Gelombang tersebar melalui celah atau sekitar penghalang; paling ketara apabila celah ≈ λ

back.en: Resultant displacement = sum of the individual displacements
back.bm: Sesaran paduan = hasil tambah sesaran individu

back.en: Transverse, no medium needed, 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ in vacuum, carry energy
back.bm: Melintang, tidak perlu medium, 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ dalam vakum, membawa tenaga

back.en: Gamma, X-ray, UV, visible, infrared, microwave, radio
back.bm: Gama, sinar-X, UV, cahaya nampak, inframerah, gelombang mikro, radio

back.en: Amplitude: maximum displacement. Frequency: vibrations per second (Hz). Period: time for one vibration (s)
back.bm: Amplitud: sesaran maksimum. Frekuensi: bilangan ayunan sesaat (Hz). Tempoh: masa satu ayunan (s)

tip.en: f = 1/T — a higher frequency means a shorter period.
tip.bm: f = 1/T — frekuensi lebih tinggi bermaksud tempoh lebih pendek.

back.en: d = vt ÷ 2, because the wave travels to the seabed and back
back.bm: d = vt ÷ 2, kerana gelombang bergerak ke dasar laut dan kembali

example.en: v = 1,500 m s⁻¹ in sea water, echo after 0.4 s → d = 1,500 × 0.4 ÷ 2 = 300 m.
example.bm: v = 1,500 m s⁻¹ dalam air laut, gema selepas 0.4 s → d = 1,500 × 0.4 ÷ 2 = 300 m.

back.en: Gamma: cancer treatment, sterilising. X-ray: imaging bones. UV: sterilising, checking banknotes. Infrared: remote controls, thermal cameras. Microwave: cooking, satellite links. Radio: broadcasting
back.bm: Gama: rawatan kanser, pensterilan. Sinar-X: mengimej tulang. UL: pensterilan, menyemak wang kertas. Inframerah: alat kawalan jauh, kamera terma. Gelombang mikro: memasak, komunikasi satelit. Radio: penyiaran

tip.en: Shorter wavelength = higher energy = more dangerous to living cells.
tip.bm: Panjang gelombang lebih pendek = tenaga lebih tinggi = lebih berbahaya kepada sel hidup.
